timing_source: WordBoundary of the same synthesis; no estimated word timer

audio/ar-book-corner-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ رَمْزًا لِرُكْنِ الْكُتُبِ. أَضِفْ اِسْمَ الرُّكْنِ لِيَعْرِفَهُ الْجَمِيعُ.

audio/ar-feelings-prompt.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ لَوْنًا لِشُعُورِكَ الْيَوْمَ. اُرْسُمْ وَاحْكِ عَمَّا تَعْنِيهِ.

audio/ar-feelings-real_world.mp3.text: احكِ عن شعورك إن أحببت؛ لا يوجد لون صحيح للشعور.

audio/ar-guide-draw.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ فِكْرَتَكَ. كُلُّ رَسْمَةٍ لَهَا مَعْنًى.

audio/ar-guide-guide.mp3.text: هَذَا دَلِيلٌ اِخْتِيَارِيٌّ. جَرِّبْ بِحُرِّيَّةٍ وَعُدْ إِلَى رَسْمِكَ.

audio/ar-guide-library.mp3.text: اِخْتَرْ مُسْتَوًى وَمَشْرُوعًا. كُلُّ الْمُسْتَوَيَاتِ مُتَاحَةٌ لَكَ.

audio/ar-guide-meaning.mp3.text: أَضِفْ كَلِمَةً أَوْ رِسَالَةً. يُمْكِنُكَ الْحَكْيُ بَدَلَ الْكِتَابَةِ.

audio/ar-guide-next.mp3.text: اِسْتَرِحْ مِنَ الشَّاشَةِ وَجَرِّبْ رِسَالَتَكَ فِي الْحَيَاةِ.

audio/ar-guide-ready.mp3.text: حَفِظْنَا مُحَاوَلَتَكَ. شَارِكْ مَعْنَاهَا مَعَ شَخْصٍ تَخْتَارُهُ.

audio/ar-guide-review.mp3.text: اِقْرَأْ رِسَالَتَكَ. هَلْ تُعَبِّرُ عَمَّا تُرِيدُ؟

audio/ar-guide-saved.mp3.text: هَذِهِ مَشْرُوعَاتُكَ. يُمْكِنُكَ فَتْحُهَا أَوْ تَعْدِيلُ نُسْخَةٍ مِنْهَا.

audio/ar-help-sign-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ رَمْزًا لِمَكَانٍ فِي الْبَيْتِ. أَضِفْ عِبَارَةً تَدُلُّ عَلَى مَا نَفْعَلُهُ هُنَاكَ.

audio/ar-help-sign-real_world.mp3.text: جرب استخدام اللافتة في مكانها الحقيقي.

audio/ar-kind-message-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ لِصَدِيقٍ. أَضِفْ عِبَارَةً تُدْخِلُ السُّرُورَ عَلَيْهِ.

audio/ar-my-request-model.mp3.text: هَلْ نَقْرَأُ قِصَّةً مَعًا؟ أُحِبُّ وَقْتَ الْقِرَاءَةِ.

audio/ar-my-request-prompt.mp3.text: فَكِّرْ فِي شَيْءٍ تُرِيدُهُ. اُكْتُبْ طَلَبًا لَطِيفًا وَاذْكُرْ سَبَبَكَ. رَاجِعْهُ مَعَ الْمُرَافِقِ.

audio/ar-my-request-real_world.mp3.text: اقرأ طلبك للمرافق واستمع إلى رده.

audio/ar-my-world-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ شَيْئًا تُحِبُّهُ. ثُمَّ أَخْبِرْ مَنْ مَعَكَ عَنْهُ.

audio/ar-my-world-real_world.mp3.text: اعرض الرسمة لشخص معك وأشر إلى الجزء الذي تقصده.

audio/ar-name-tag-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ رَمْزًا لِحَقِيبَتِكَ. أَضِفْ اِسْمَكَ بِالْكِتَابَةِ أَوْ بِمُسَاعَدَةِ الْمُرَافِقِ.

audio/ar-name-tag-real_world.mp3.text: اطبع بطاقة الاسم وضعها على حقيبتك بمساعدة بالغ.

audio/ar-play-invite-prompt.mp3.text: لِمَنْ تَكْتُبُ؟ اُرْسُمْ لُعْبَةً. أَضِفْ طَلَبًا وَمَكَانًا لِلَّعِبِ.

audio/ar-play-invite-real_world.mp3.text: اقرأ دعوتك للمرافق واتفقا على وقت ومكان آمنين.

audio/ar-reason-thanks-prompt.mp3.text: اُكْتُبْ لِمَنْ سَاعَدَكَ. وَضِّحْ مَا فَعَلَهُ وَكَيْفَ شَعَرْتَ. أَضِفْ رَسْمَكَ.

audio/ar-reason-thanks-real_world.mp3.text: راجع مع القارئ هل عرف سبب شكرك.

audio/ar-thank-you-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ هَدِيَّةً مِنْ قَلْبِكَ. قُلْ لِمَنْ تُرِيدُ أَنْ تَشْكُرَهُ لِمَاذَا.

audio/ar-two-page-book-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ مَا حَدَثَ أَوَّلًا. فِي الصَّفْحَةِ الثَّانِيَةِ اُرْسُمْ مَا حَدَثَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ. أَضِفْ تَعْلِيقًا لِكُلِّ صَفْحَةٍ.

audio/ar-two-page-book-real_world.mp3.text: احكِ قصتك لشخص باستعمال صفحتي كتابك.

audio/ar-word-picture-prompt.mp3.text: اُرْسُمْ زَهْرَةً أَوْ شَيْئًا آخَرَ. أَضِفْ كَلِمَةً تَدُلُّ عَلَى رَسْمِكَ.

audio/ar-word-picture-real_world.mp3.text: اعثر على الشيء الحقيقي وأشر إلى كلمته في البطاقة.

audio/en-book-corner-prompt.mp3.text: Draw a sign for your reading corner. Add a word so people can find it.

audio/en-book-corner-real_world.mp3.text: Place your sign beside your books.

audio/en-feelings-prompt.mp3.text: Choose a colour for how you feel today. Draw and tell what it means.

audio/en-feelings-real_world.mp3.text: Tell someone about your feeling if you want. Any colour can fit.

audio/en-guide-draw.mp3.text: Draw your idea. Every picture can tell us something.

audio/en-guide-guide.mp3.text: This guide is optional. Try freely, then return to your picture.

audio/en-guide-library.mp3.text: Choose a level and a project. Every level is open to you.

audio/en-guide-meaning.mp3.text: Add a word or a message. You can tell your idea instead of writing.

audio/en-guide-next.mp3.text: Take a break from the screen and try using your message in real life.

audio/en-guide-ready.mp3.text: Your attempt is saved. Tell someone you choose what it means.

audio/en-guide-review.mp3.text: Read your message. Does it say what you want it to say?

audio/en-guide-saved.mp3.text: These are your projects. Open one or edit a copy.

audio/en-help-sign-prompt.mp3.text: Draw a symbol for a place at home. Add a phrase about what happens there.

audio/en-help-sign-real_world.mp3.text: Try using your sign in the real place.

audio/en-kind-message-model.mp3.text: I am glad we are friends.

audio/en-kind-message-prompt.mp3.text: Draw a picture for a friend. Add a phrase that could make them smile.

audio/en-kind-message-real_world.mp3.text: Give your note to a friend if you want.

audio/en-my-request-model.mp3.text: Could we read a story together? I love our reading time.

audio/en-my-request-prompt.mp3.text: Think of something you would like. Write a kind request and a reason. Review it with a grown-up.

audio/en-my-request-real_world.mp3.text: Read your request to a grown-up and listen to their reply.

audio/en-my-world-prompt.mp3.text: Draw something you love. Tell a grown-up about your picture.

audio/en-my-world-real_world.mp3.text: Show your picture to someone and point to the part you mean.

audio/en-name-tag-prompt.mp3.text: Draw a symbol for your bag. Add your name yourself or ask a grown-up to write it.

audio/en-name-tag-real_world.mp3.text: Print your name tag and attach it with a grown-up.

audio/en-play-invite-model.mp3.text: Come and play in the garden.

audio/en-play-invite-prompt.mp3.text: Who is your invitation for? Draw a game. Add a request and a place to play.

audio/en-play-invite-real_world.mp3.text: Read your invitation with a grown-up and agree on a safe place and time.

audio/en-reason-thanks-model.mp3.text: Thank you for helping me. Your kindness made me happy.

audio/en-reason-thanks-prompt.mp3.text: Write to someone who helped you. Explain what they did and how you felt. Add your picture.

audio/en-reason-thanks-real_world.mp3.text: Ask your reader if your note explains why you are thankful.

audio/en-thank-you-prompt.mp3.text: Draw a gift from your heart. Tell someone why you are thankful.

audio/en-thank-you-real_world.mp3.text: Give the card to someone who helped you.

audio/en-two-page-book-model.mp3.text: I planted a seed. Then a flower grew.

audio/en-two-page-book-prompt.mp3.text: Draw what happened first. On the second page, draw what happened next. Add a caption to each page.

audio/en-two-page-book-real_world.mp3.text: Tell someone your story using both pages.

audio/en-word-picture-prompt.mp3.text: Draw a flower or something else. Add a word that tells us what you drew.

audio/en-word-picture-real_world.mp3.text: Find the real thing and point to its word on your card.

audio/coach/en-color.mp3.text: Pick a colour you like from the circles.

audio/coach/en-draw.mp3.text: Draw something you like on the canvas.

audio/coach/ar-paper.mp3.text: اِخْتَرِ الحَدِيقَةَ، أَوِ السَّمَكَةَ، أَوِ الصَّارُوخَ.

audio/coach/en-paper.mp3.text: Choose the garden, the fish or the rocket.

audio/coach/ar-colour.mp3.text: لَوِّنْ جُزْءًا مِنَ الصُّورَةِ بِاللَّوْنِ الَّذِي اخْتَرْتَهُ.

audio/coach/en-colour.mp3.text: Colour part of the picture with your chosen colour.

audio/coach/en-choose-photo.mp3.text: Pick a picture from My Things.

audio/coach/ar-place-photo.mp3.text: اِلْمَسِ اللَّوْحَةَ أَيْنَمَا تُرِيدُ وَضْعَ الصُّورَةِ.

audio/coach/en-place-photo.mp3.text: Tap the canvas where you want the picture.

audio/coach/ar-meaning.mp3.text: عِنْدَمَا تَنْتَهِي مِنَ الرَّسْمِ، اِضْغَطْ «أُضِيفُ كَلَامِي».

audio/coach/en-meaning.mp3.text: When your drawing is ready, tap Add words.

audio/coach/ar-words.mp3.text: أَضِفْ كَلِمَةً، أَوْ أَمْلِ رِسَالَتَكَ عَلَى مَنْ مَعَكَ.

audio/coach/en-words.mp3.text: Add a word, or ask your grown-up to write down your message.

audio/coach/ar-review.mp3.text: خُذْ وَقْتَكَ. عِنْدَمَا تَكُونُ جَاهِزًا، اِضْغَطْ «أَرَى وَأَحْفَظُ».

audio/coach/en-review.mp3.text: Take your time. When you’re ready, tap See and save.

audio/coach/en-review-message.mp3.text: When your card is ready, tap See and save.

audio/coach/ar-save.mp3.text: اِضْغَطْ «أَحْفَظُ فِي مَعْرِضِي» لِتَجِدَ عَمَلَكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى.

audio/coach/en-save.mp3.text: Tap Save to my gallery so you can find your picture again.

audio/coach/en-done.mp3.text: Well done! Your picture is in your gallery.

audio/coach/en-free-prompt.mp3.text: What would you like to draw today?
